raw_html: [[Proof Against Disease|Quality Proof Against Disease +2]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Proof Against Disease|Quality Proof Against Disease +2]]:''' This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +2 [[Quality bonus]] to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 3 + their Fortitude save).
